uncovered_item_details.paper_location: p.4, Fig. 2, plus-symbol data and caption
uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: The full plotted Ising S_L series at the caption parameters, its visual data object, and slope/intercept residuals.
direct_gap_statements: The literal overall minus sign in printed Eq. (3) gives a degenerate ferromagnetic XXX ground manifold, while Fig. 2 describes and displays a critical antiferromagnetic free-boson curve.

direct_cause.statement: The literal overall minus sign in printed Eq. (3) gives a degenerate ferromagnetic XXX ground manifold, while Fig. 2 describes and displays a critical antiferromagnetic free-boson curve.

root_cause.statement: The printed Hamiltonian and the figure caption specify mutually incompatible XXX ground-state physics; author intent is probably the antiferromagnetic convention, but only fresh review may promote this to a paper-error candidate.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No reproduction-code fault was found after parameter, convergence, independent full-Hilbert-space, analytic-limit, and isolated-execution checks.

checks.statement: N=20, Delta=1, zero field, periodic boundary, and both signs are bound to printed sources.
Loose and tight Lanczos tolerances agree in energy to 1e-10 and block entropies to 5e-9 on an independent N=10 test.
The fixed-magnetization sparse Hamiltonian agrees with a separately constructed full Pauli Hilbert-space Hamiltonian.
The literal ferromagnetic convention contains both a zero-entropy polarized state and a nonzero-entropy symmetric Dicke representative, proving ground-state ambiguity analytically.
The paper-scale N=20 run returned zero with no forbidden file accesses.
